reason: The free first visit is a no-brainer and I'd try it with my toddler on a work-from-home day. After that we'd maybe go once or twice a month, so I'd pay the $13 drop-in. A membership doesn't pay off for us.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, which isn't enough to justify a membership. On $50k, $13 a visit adds up fast if it's not special, and it's a 15-minute drive from Fruitland.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price closer to $8-10, or a pack that doesn't expire and works out well under $10 a visit.
